verdict.rationale: cubic offers some programmatic access of its own: an Analytics API for PR-level data, and an MCP server that can read findings, request reviews, triage issues, and manage subscriptions and seats. It also supports cubic.yaml config-as-code. Nothing shows parity with the UI: no general REST API or OpenAPI spec was found (the probe got 404s), and many UI actions like Fix with cubic, custom-agent library adoption, auto-approval settings and the wiki have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API covering all UI actions, an OpenAPI/reference spec, explicit API/UI parity claim, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed, how much AI code was authored, etc.
cubic's MCP server lets your coding agent read review findings, look up codebase documentation, request PR reviews, triage PR or codebase scan issues
You can now ask your coding agent to check your cubic subscription, manage team seats and roles, and purchase more seats without leaving your MCP client.
